name: Main tower groups
kicker: Cham brick towers in a forested valley
summary: Walk the brick that still stands, mostly groups B, C, and D, on a morning from Hoi An. The information page lists 150,000 VND for a foreign adult. On 21 Oct 2026 the purchase page showed 148,000 VND, so read the amount before you pay. Closing is printed as both 17:00 and 18:00. Skip it if ruins are not your day.
timeNeeded: A morning. Time on the paths is check on arrival.
getThere: 45 km by road from Hoi An. The minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Brick towers in the valley, with the mountain behind

notice.title: The close is not one time
notice.body: A 2019 notice closes the site at 17:00. The live ticket site sells tickets until 17:30 and ends visiting at 18:00. Come in the morning. Do not treat 18:00 as a promise.

body: Stop at the museum by the Khe Thẻ stream, then take the electric cart. The ride is about 2 km, and the 2020 guide includes it in the entrance ticket. A management essay from 25 Feb 2025 says French surveys exposed 72 structures in 13 lettered groups, and that about 20 towers still stand, mostly in B, C, and D. Tower A1, which that essay calls 24 meters, came down in the 1969 bombing. A conservation note from the day before counts more than 40 temple structures still relatively intact, plus the enclosure walls. UNESCO’s inscription still says eight groups and 71 monuments. Those totals do not match. Walk what the board has open.

A group, on the architecture page of 17 May 2019, sits inside a thick brick wall. The main tower usually opens to the east. A few large towers also have a west door. A gate tower stands in front, then a long hall with a tile roof, where pilgrims left offerings and the dances were held. The same page names the styles in the valley: Mỹ Sơn E1, Hòa Lai, Đồng Dương, Mỹ Sơn A1, Ponaga, and Bình Định, in fired brick and sandstone. The walls are the brick. Door frames, lintels, and the altar stones are the sandstone. Tower B1 is the one with a stone base. The linga from B1 is in the museum, not the linga and yoni that still stand in the open. In group B, an original wall of tower B4 is dated to the 9th century, in the Đồng Dương style.

Group G is the Italian restoration. The 25 Feb 2025 essay says Italian experts surveyed the valley from 1997 to 2000, and that Italy funded the work there with UNESCO’s backing. The daytime show is at the foot of that group, and the conservation note says group G also uses laterite. Tower E7 is a boat-roofed kosagrha. The same essay says it was restored from 2011 to 2015 and calls that roof one of the most intact of the type. A 16 Aug 2021 essay says bomb fragments found when A1 was cleared are displayed in tower D2, and that reliefs are kept inside D1 and D2. Do not climb the brick, do not eat in the monument area, and do not use flash on the stone. Stay on the paths. UNESCO still records unidentified unexploded ordnance in the buffer zone.

gettingThere: Cars stop at the museum. An electric cart covers about 2 km along the Khe Thẻ stream, and that ride is inside the entrance ticket on the 2019 service note and the 2020 guide. There is no train into the valley. Tourism bus 01DL, from Hoi An, is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026, and the notice names no replacement.

legs.heading: From Hoi An
legs.body: By road. The sanctuary prints 45 km and no drive time. The minutes are check on arrival. You cannot walk it. Bus 01DL is paused from 15 Sep 2026 for six months.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: By road. The sanctuary prints 68 km from the city and no drive time. The airport door is a separate unsourced leg. Check the minutes on arrival.

hours: Opens at 06:00. A 2019 notice closes at 17:00. The 2020 guide, the live ticket site, and the 2026 city list end visiting at 18:00. Ticket sales end at 17:00 on the 2020 guide and at 17:30 on the live ticket site.
closed: No weekly closing day is published. The 2019 notice says every day, including holidays. Bad weather can stop the show at group G.
admissionNote: The information page, the 2020 guide, the 2019 price notice, and the 2026 city list print non-resident adult 150,000 VND and Vietnamese adult 100,000 VND. The information page says that price includes VAT and that the purchase page is the figure that can change. On 21 Oct 2026 the purchase page showed 148,000 VND for a foreign adult and 99,000 VND for a Vietnamese adult. Read the amount before you pay. Children are not one rule. The 2020 guide says 30,000 VND from age 5 to 15. The information page says children 5 to 15 buy a 30,000 VND shuttle ticket and children under 5 are free. On 21 Oct 2026 the purchase page showed a child ticket at 30,000 VND on that service type and did not print ages. The 2026 city list does not print a child band. Check the child fare on arrival. The 2020 guide says the adult ticket includes the museum, the electric cart, a Cham folk performance, and the monuments. An on-site explanation of 100,000 VND for one to five guests is only on that 2020 guide. The green bicycle, the audio guide, pottery, and hat-weaving have no published price.
